payload.title: notification bell shows unread count after a new alert
payload.errorMessage:
expect(locator).toHaveText(expected) failed

Locator: getByTestId('unread-count')
Expected: "1"
Received: "0"

note: An unread count stuck at 0 looks like the notification never registered — a real bug — and this run recorded one failure, with no retry evidence either way. But the badge is driven by two independent sources: an initial REST fetch on page load and a websocket push for new events; when the push arrives before the initial fetch resolves, the fetch's response briefly overwrites the pushed count with a stale 0 before self-correcting. A steady ~12.5% historical rate confined to page-load-adjacent assertions — intermittent, not zero, not dominant — doesn't match a lost-notification bug, which would reproduce whenever the same trigger fires; it matches a load-order race instead.
